implement_LanguageModel_subclass: implement a concrete subclass of LanguageModel that provides sample_text and sample_choice methods
implement_sample_text: implement the sample_text abstract method to generate text from a prompt with temperature and top_p controls
implement_sample_choice: implement the sample_choice abstract method to select from a list of candidate responses given a prompt
handle_InvalidResponseError: handle InvalidResponseError exceptions when sample_choice fails to produce a valid response after retries
configure_sampling_defaults: configure default sampling parameters like temperature top_p top_k max_tokens and timeout for language model requests
